{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str)
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Apply filters: keep only completed orders that are not QA
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Check the number of rows after filtering
assert len(filtered_df) == 815, f'Expected 815 rows, got {len(filtered_df)}'

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Confirm conversion rate is a fraction
assert 0 <= conversion_rate <= 1, f'Conversion rate {conversion_rate} is not in [0, 1]'

# Print result
conversion_rate"}
